# Celoris Complete Catalog & Curriculum Index
This document provides complete plain-text schemas and syllabus outlines for the Celoris ecosystem.

---

## 1. Creative Studio Suites

### Video Studio (Video Editor)
- **URL**: https://www.celorisdesigns.com/video-studio
- **Description**: A free, browser-based, high-performance video editor. Features multi-track timeline editing, filters, captions, transition effects, and export in HD. Optimized for YouTube, Instagram Reels, and TikTok formatting.

### Image Studio (Design Platform)
- **URL**: https://www.celorisdesigns.com/image-studio
- **Description**: Canvas-style design dashboard. Background removal in 1-click, AI object replacement, font pairings, premium templates, vector asset editor.

### AI Explorer (20+ AI Models)
- **URL**: https://www.celorisdesigns.com/ai-explorer
- **Description**: A sandbox featuring state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary models. Text generation (Llama, DeepSeek), Image generation (Stable Diffusion, Flux), and voice synthesis/cloning tools.

---

## 2. Advanced Courses & Syllabi Detailed

### Vibe Coding Mastery: Spec-Driven Development
- **URL**: https://www.celorisdesigns.com/courses/vibe-coding-mastery
- **Price**: Free
- **Duration**: 4 Weeks (20 Hours)
- **Prerequisites**: Basic understanding of code execution.
- **Curriculum**:
  - Chapter 1: Syntax is Secondary to Intent.
  - Chapter 2: The 'Command Center' workflow with Cursor & Windsurf.
  - Chapter 3: Writing robust Specification-Driven Markdown documents.
  - Chapter 4: Automated agents testing and debugging.

### CBSE Class 10 Physics Master Course: CBSE/NCERT
- **URL**: https://www.celorisdesigns.com/courses/cbse-class-10-physics-light-electricity-magnetism-energy
- **Price**: ₹1500
- **Duration**: PT40H (40 Hours)
- **Syllabus**:
  - Chapter 1: Light - Reflection and Refraction (spherical mirrors, lenses).
  - Chapter 2: The Human Eye and the Colorful World (Myopia, hypermetropia, prism dispersion).
  - Chapter 3: Electricity (Ohm's Law V=IR, resistance, series/parallel combinations).
  - Chapter 4: Magnetic Effects of Electric Current (Field lines, electromagnetism, induction).

### Agentic AI Systems: Design, Build, and Deploy
- **URL**: https://www.celorisdesigns.com/courses/agentic-ai-systems-design-build-deploy
- **Price**: Free
- **Duration**: 6 Weeks
- **Syllabus**:
  - Chapter 1: Foundations of Agents (ReAct Loop, Planning, Tools).
  - Chapter 2: Multi-Agent Systems & Orchestration.
  - Chapter 3: Memory architectures (Short-term, episodic, RAG vector lookup).
  - Chapter 4: Agent evaluation, guardrails, and deployment constraints.
